extracted.name: Pepperoni Dip II
extracted.description: Cut plain bagels into bite-sized pieces and dip them into this simple hot dip made with pepperoni and cream cheese.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a medium baking dish, mix the pepperoni, cream of mushroom soup and cream cheese.
Bake uncovered 15 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.
